releaseNotes: NChat 1.0.62 — notifications now take you exactly where they point. (1) A message notification opens the chat on that message: it scrolls straight to it and rings it briefly, instead of dropping you at the bottom of the conversation to hunt for what was said. (2) A call notification now opens the call screen itself. Tapping it re-opens the ringing call if it is still ringing; if the caller already hung up it does nothing rather than showing a call that no longer exists. (3) The unread badge stays gone. Reading a chat — including one opened from a notification — now clears it for good: the count is marked read on this device the moment you tap, so a list refresh that lands a split second before the server catches up can no longer put the badge back after you press back. Anything that arrives while you are inside the chat is also marked read as it arrives, so leaving the chat shows zero.
